fields.name: headline
fields.label: Headline
fields.description:
Wrap words in *asterisks* to set them in the gold italic. Use
to force a line break.

fields.name: startDateISO
fields.label: Start date and time
fields.description: Used by Google for the event listing. Set the other two date fields to match.

fields.name: startDateLong
fields.label: Start date, written out
fields.description: Shown in the details table. e.g. "Wednesday 7 October 2026"

fields.name: startDateShort
fields.label: Start date, short
fields.description: Used in card blurbs and page descriptions. e.g. "7 October"

fields.name: priceFull
fields.label: Price for the full run (number only)

fields.name: costLine
fields.label: Cost, written out
fields.description: Shown in the table. e.g. "$25 per session, or $150 for the full six weeks"

fields.name: enrolling
fields.label: Currently enrolling
fields.description: Untick when the cohort fills. The page then says the group is closed.

fields.name: phoneHref
fields.label: Phone, as dialled
fields.description: Must stay in the form tel:+13037369822

fields.name: published
fields.label: Published
fields.description: Off = nobody can see it, not even by guessing the address. Turn it on when you're ready, and it appears on the Journal page within a couple of minutes.

fields.name: slug
fields.label: Web address
fields.description: Lowercase words with hyphens, e.g. what-emdr-feels-like

fields.name: excerpt
fields.label: Summary
fields.description: One or two sentences. Shows on the Journal page and in Google results.

fields.name: heroAlt
fields.label: Image description
fields.description: Describe the picture for people using a screen reader. One plain sentence.

fields.name: body
fields.label: Post
fields.description: One box per paragraph. Start a box with ## to make it a heading. Use the + button to add another paragraph.

fields.name: answer
fields.label: Answer
fields.description: Plain sentences. Separate paragraphs with a blank line. Basic HTML links are allowed.

description.value: References another document, used as a foreign key
